rules.title: Application factory
rules.text: Create the app with a factory function and register blueprints inside it.

rules.title: Blueprints per domain
rules.text: Split routes into blueprints by domain.

rules.title: Config classes
rules.text: Load configuration from environment-specific objects or from_prefixed_env, and never hardcode SECRET_KEY.

rules.title: Validate input
rules.text: Validate request data with a schema library (marshmallow or pydantic).
